# nhl-api-ts

> TypeScript SDK and CLI for the public NHL web API (api-web.nhle.com) and stats API (api.nhle.com/stats/rest): teams, rosters, schedules, scores, boxscores, play-by-play, standings, player/team/skater/goalie stats, and NHL EDGE tracking. Node.js >= 24, ESM only, zero dependencies, no API key.

Key facts:

- `import { createNHLClient } from 'nhl-api-ts'; const client = createNHLClient();` then `await client.<module>.<method>({ ...options })`.
- Modules: teams, standings, schedule, gameCenter, stats, edge, players, misc, helpers. Every method is async and takes one options object with camelCase keys.
- Every SDK method is also a CLI command: `npx nhl-api-ts <module-kebab> <method-kebab> [args] --compact` prints JSON.
- Seasons are `YYYYYYYY` (20232024). Game ids are `YYYYTTNNNN` (2023020280). Game type: 1 preseason, 2 regular, 3 playoffs.
- Stats API pages are capped at 100 rows. HTTP errors extend `NHLApiException`. Invalid input throws `RangeError`.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewangelle/nhl-api-ts/main/README.md): Install, quick start, the full method list per module, CLI usage
- [Concepts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewangelle/nhl-api-ts/main/docs/concepts.md): Client and modules, ID formats, the two APIs, "now" redirects, pagination, filtering, retries
- [Errors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewangelle/nhl-api-ts/main/docs/errors.md): Every error class and code, with cause and fix, plus CLI exit codes
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewangelle/nhl-api-ts/main/skills/nhl-api-ts/SKILL.md): Condensed guide to choosing methods and avoiding common mistakes

## Recipes

- [Filter skater stats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewangelle/nhl-api-ts/main/docs/recipes/filter-skater-stats.md): buildQuery filters, report types, sorting, aggregation
- [Paginate stats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewangelle/nhl-api-ts/main/docs/recipes/paginate-stats.md): start/limit paging, the 100-row cap, fetching all rows
- [Today's games and live scores](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewangelle/nhl-api-ts/main/docs/recipes/live-scores.md): Daily schedule, scores, game states, polling
- [Season-wide data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewangelle/nhl-api-ts/main/docs/recipes/season-wide-data.md): Every game id, every player, bulk stats with helpers
- [Extending response types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewangelle/nhl-api-ts/main/docs/recipes/extending-response-types.md): Module augmentation for fields, play types and report rows, and the per-call cast
- [Retries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewangelle/nhl-api-ts/main/docs/recipes/retries.md): Backoff on 429/5xx/timeouts, pacing bulk loops
- [CLI and jq](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewangelle/nhl-api-ts/main/docs/recipes/cli-and-jq.md): Command mapping, structured options, jq one-liners
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewangelle/nhl-api-ts/main/docs/recipes/testing.md): Mocking fetch to test code that uses the SDK
